title: Don't hit send
hook: Report done at 1:12 am. Don't hit send.

caption:
report done at 1:12 am. send it now and 1 am becomes your new deadline.

write it tonight, then schedule send: click the arrow next to send (or the three dots on your phone), pick 9:30 am, and turn on do not disturb.

what time did you last send a work email? just the time.

Comment BOSS and I'll DM you the schedule send and undo send steps for phone and laptop, plus 3 prompts for calm replies to late night boss messages.
